description: The top of PLATINUM ROAD: the glowing Vice Night Highway masthead sign, the neon-road progress bar at 15% with eight trophies stamped EARNED, the full dash-panel control row (search, kind/grade/state filters, spoiler shield, export/import), and the first mile-marker trophy cards of the checklist, each showing its guide line.

The Roadmap to Platinum rendered as six green highway exit signs — First Nights in Vice City, The Story Freeway, Friends & Final Favors, Collectors' Causeway, Leonida Playground and The Final Mile — each with its trophy chips and its own earned-progress meter.

The trophy detail view open on The Shootist (silver): the official description, kind and grade, the full strategy guide in our own words, the sources line crediting the official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles, and its target counter part-filled at 27 of 42 range golds.

The checklist with the Spoiler Shield switched ON in the dash panel: unearned story trophies have their names and descriptions masked behind neon blur bars, while earned trophies and non-story cards stay readable.
